notes.title: Wholesome Games Celebration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894378/4dad857413119596ffc28fc59fef396abfbc2d61.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that[i][b] The Final Farewell[/b][/i] is participating in the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration from [b]Aug 15th - 21st[/b]! This is a cozy celebration that showcases games that inspire optimism, joy, and introspection. 😊

To celebrate, the game will be [b]20% off[/b] for the duration of the event- so don't miss out!

And be sure to check out all the other amazing wholesome games that are participating, by visiting the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames] Events Page[/url].

notes.title: The Makers of The Final Farewell Release New Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have been busy with the release of our next title! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396660/Anchored_Hearts_A_Tale_of_Destiny/]Anchored Hearts: A Tale of Destiny[/url]!

Some of you may have seen us showcase this game at an event alongside [i]The Final Farewell[/i]. If you think that on paper the two games don't have much in common - you're right that there are plenty of differences. [i]Anchored Hearts[/i] has pirates, romance, and a much longer story. Rather than walking around gathering items, you engage in exciting ship battles which are easy to learn and rewarding to master.

Fundamentally though, they're both [i]Studio Witchstar[/i] games. The lead writer and creative director of [i]The Final Farewell[/i] is also one of the main writers on [i]Anchored Hearts[/i]. She writes with humour and feeling, and if you love the quality of her writing, consider giving the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396660/Anchored_Hearts_A_Tale_of_Destiny/]Anchored Hearts Demo[/url] a go!

In the meantime, our team is having a well-deserved rest. In July, we hope to update [i]The Final Farewell[/i]!

Anyway, check out our new release, and have a lovely summer!

notes.title: The Final Farewell - 1 Month Update
notes.content:
It's been a month since our tiny team released The Final Farewell, our little love-packed game about grief. We had no idea what to expect. In this time, ~100 people have played the game, and 17 left a review.

Every single one of them positive.

100%

Wow.

Thank you. 😭

This has given our little game the "Positive" label on Steam. For a small indie like us, this is a huge achievement! And we couldn't have done it without you. 😊

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

We're soon releasing our next game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396660/Anchored_Hearts_A_Tale_of_Destiny]Anchored Hearts[/url]! This pirate adventure/romance with real time ship battles is coming out June, so everyone is hard at work on that right now!

However, we haven't forgotten The Final Farewell. A few bugs were reported which we're working on fixing. We also want to add some other features and content, so that's what we're discussing at the moment.

Is there anything you would really love us to add to The Final Farewell? Let us know in the comments! ✨
